title: Missing None check for environ
detail: The method now accepts only None for the environ parameter, but later code assumes environ is a dict. If get_response is called with environ=None, the code will later try to use environ as a dict, causing a TypeError.

title: parse_cookie now rejects WSGIEnvironment
detail: The original signature allowed a WSGIEnvironment dict, which callers passed to parse_cookie. The new signature only accepts a string or None, so passing an environ dict will raise a TypeError or produce incorrect parsing.

title: Missing return on exception in _safe_is_dir
detail: When an OSError occurs, the function falls through without returning a value, resulting in None. This None is used as a boolean in callers, causing unintended truthiness and potentially skipping directory handling.
